# do_ExpressionHeatmap() | Expression heatmap

```{r}
#| results: "asis"
#| echo: false
source("../_common.R")
```

Expression heatmaps display gene expression patterns across cells or groups.

## Basic usage

```{r}
#| eval: false
p <- SCpubr::do_ExpressionHeatmap(sample = sample,
                                  features = c("CD3D", "CD8A", "CD4"))
p
```
